key.title: Key
key.description: Key used to identify the attachment inside the document.

code.title: Code
code.description: Code used to identify the payload of the attachment.

name.title: Name
name.description: Filename of the attachment. Overrides the name retrieved from the URL.

description.title: Description
description.description: Why the attachment is included and what it contains.

url.title: URL
url.description: URL of where to find the attachment.

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: Used to verify the integrity of the attachment when downloaded from the URL.

org.Attachment.description: An Attachment provides a structure to be used to attach documents inside a GOBL document, either as a reference via a URL, or directly as a base64 encoded string.
